claims.text: The retained Kimi Code ‘What’s New’ page is a living product history whose reviewed content does not itself preserve a January K2.5/Kimi Code release entry with sufficient precision for this task.

limitations.text: First-party Kimi materials elsewhere identify Kimi K2.5 as a January 27 release, but that item-level source is not part of this task’s retained locator set.
The living page includes much later Kimi Code history, creating a high risk of later-state contamination if used to reconstruct January features.
